name: Atom Assault
storyline:
WELCOME TO ATOM ASSAULT, RTS CHAOS STARTS NOW!
Atom Assault is a full 3D indie RTS where strategy and stupidity hold hands. Everything explodes, infantry fish for money, and you can literally pilot nukes. From the creators of Nuke Them All, this is classic RTS energy with a cheeky twist and graphics inspired by Totally Accurate Battle Simulator and Minecraft.
summary: Atom Assault throws you into a chaotic Red vs Blue war where everything explodes, infantry fish for money, and you can even pilot nukes in first person. Full 3D, fully destructible world, fast, funny, proudly indie. If you miss old school RTS mayhem, this one hits hard.
